title: fix: send Inkling Opus audio as Ogg
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Sends OpenAI `opus` input to Fireworks with its documented `audio/ogg` media type.
- Keeps the public `input_audio` contract unchanged.
- Adds focused coverage for the exact Ogg/Opus transformation.

Test: `npx vitest run test/text/transforms/inputAudioToFireworks.test.ts` (3 passed)

gist.headline: Opus finds its proper jar
gist.blurb: Inkling Opus audio now arrives at Fireworks in the Ogg container it expects. Same public input shape, fewer tiny format misunderstandings buzzing around the hive.
gist.summary: Fixed the Fireworks input transform so OpenAI `opus` audio is sent as `audio/ogg`, while keeping the public `input_audio` contract unchanged.
gist.impact: Apps sending Opus audio through Inkling can now reach Fireworks with the documented Ogg media type, without changing their existing `input_audio` payloads.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli carefully carrying a small musical Ogg jar labeled “OPUS” along a garden path into a cozy Fireworks-style audio terminal, while a monitor robot confirms the format with a green waveform. The jar-and-terminal metaphor represents preserving the public audio input while packaging Opus in the media container Fireworks expects; code-plants and flowers keep it rooted in the pollinations garden.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-dark-brown striped bee mascot with black antennae, oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, light-blue rounded wings, and tiny sound-engineer headphones, carrying a small jar labeled “OPUS OGG” to a retro audio terminal with a lime green (#ecf874) waveform; a chunky CRT monitor robot holds a checkmark while flowers and code-plants grow around the cables. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle scanlines, pixel-font text: “audio/ogg”, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
